description: Geoscience Australia - Onshore Gas Pipelines 2015 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Geoscience Australia. This dataset presents locations of onshore gas pipelines in Australia. This dataset was created using the latest pipeline datasets acquired from the States and Territories, the data was uploaded into an ArcSDE environment using Feature Manipulation Engine (FME). Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Geoscience Australia. Its tags are built, gas, pipeline. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
